description: This file defines the JobTitle class, which is part of the reporting filter fields in the OrangeHRM project. It extends the FilterField class and implements ValueXNormalizable to provide filtering and value normalization functionality related to job titles within the HRM system.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Represents a filter field for job titles in HRM reports, allowing filtering by job titles and converting those titles into array form for report display or processing.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is not null, filtering employees by job title.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, in this case 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Transforms the filter value (job title ID) into an array containing its ID and label, retrieving job title details via JobTitleService.
